title: Dengue Vodcast: Insights from Recent Infectious Disease Congresses.
abstract: Dengue is the most common vector-borne viral disease. Dengue virus belongs to the Flaviviridae family, and it is predominantly transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. Dengue is a global threat to public health, with hundreds of millions of infections each year. Not only is the incidence of dengue increasing, but the geographic areas at risk are also expanding, with outbreaks in areas that have never reported dengue cases in the past, such as North America and Europe. In this vodcast, Professor Marco Aurélio Sáfadi, a pediatric infectious diseases specialist and associate professor at Santa Casa de São Paulo, Brazil, discusses key highlights of current dengue research from selected congresses held in 2025-the World Congress of the World Society for Pediatric Infectious Diseases, the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene, and the Latin American Congress of Pediatric Infectious Disease. The aim of the vodcast is to communicate the latest scientific findings and provide insights into their clinical significance. The vodcast covers a wide range of topics relating to dengue, including vaccination, surveillance and control, prophylaxis, diagnosis, management, predicting disease progression, and immune responses during dengue infection. Data from these congresses highlight the key role dengue vaccines play in disease prevention, and how vector control methods, like Wolbachia, can help reduce the spread of the disease. They also highlight the need for an integrated approach to targeting dengue, bringing together advanced diagnostic and prognostic tools, vector control techniques, and novel therapeutic and disease management strategies.Vodcast available for this article. Podcast Audio (MP4 1271498 KB).

abstract_zh: 登革热是最常见的媒介传播的病毒性疾病。登革病毒 属于黄病毒科(Flaviviridae),主要通过埃及伊蚊(Aedes aegypti)和白纹伊蚊(Aedes albopictus)媒介传播。登革热是全球公共卫生的威胁,每年有数亿感染病例。登革热的发病率 不仅在增加,风险地区的地理范围也在扩大,暴发 出现在过去从未报告过登革热病例的地区,如北美和欧洲。在本视频播客中,巴西圣保罗圣卡萨医院的儿科传染病专家、助理教授 Marco Aurélio Sáfadi 教授讨论了2025年在多个会议上发布的当前登革热研究要点——包括世界儿科传染病学会大会、美国热带医学与卫生学会大会以及拉美儿科传染病大会。该播客旨在传达最新的科学发现并提供其临床意义的见解。播客涵盖了与登革热相关的广泛主题,包括疫苗接种、监测 与控制、预防、诊断、管理、疾病进展预测以及登革热感染期间的免疫应答。会议数据强调了登革热疫苗 在疾病预防中的关键作用,以及媒介 控制方法(如 Wolbachia)如何帮助降低疾病传播。它们还强调了针对登革热的综合方法的必要性,整合先进的诊断和预后工具、媒介 控制技术以及新型治疗和疾病管理策略。本文提供视频播客。播客音频(MP4 1271498 KB)。

title: Solanaceae-Derived Spirostane Saponins Inhibit Dengue Virus Replication and Viral Protein Expression and Exhibit Activity Against Multiple Arboviruses.
abstract: ABSTRACT Mosquito‐borne arboviruses, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), represent a growing global health burden, yet no specific antiviral therapies are currently available for most of these infections. This unmet need highlights the importance of identifying novel antiviral compounds from biologically relevant sources such as plant‐derived natural products. In this study, a bioactivity‐guided approach was applied to methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species to identify compounds with antiviral activity against DENV‐2 in Vero cells. Five extracts significantly reduced viral infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non‐cytotoxic concentrations. Subsequent fractionation and purification led to the isolation of four spirostane‐type steroidal saponins, structurally characterized by UPLC‐DAD‐MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy. Functional assays demonstrated that these compounds inhibit DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers. Stage‐specific analyses revealed that their antiviral activity is primarily associated with intracellular phases of the viral life cycle, consistent with inhibition of viral replication and/or protein processing. Molecular docking analyses supported these findings by predicting favorable interactions with key viral enzymes, particularly NS5 RNA‐dependent RNA polymerase and NS3 helicase/protease. Importantly, the isolated compounds retained antiviral activity against ZIKV and CHIKV, indicating cross‐arboviral efficacy. Together, these findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad‐spectrum antiviral agents.

In this study, a bioactivity-guided approach was applied to methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species to identify compounds with antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells. Five extracts significantly reduced viral infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Subsequent fractionation and purification led to the isolation of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins, structurally characterized by UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy. Functional assays demonstrated that these compounds inhibit DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers. Stage-specific analyses revealed that their antiviral activity is primarily associated with intracellular phases of the viral life cycle, consistent with inhibition of viral replication and/or protein processing. Molecular docking analyses supported these findings by predicting favorable interactions with key viral enzymes, particularly NS5 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase and NS3 helicase/protease. Importantly, the isolated compounds retained antiviral activity against ZIKV and CHIKV, indicating cross-arboviral efficacy. Together, these findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad-spectrum antiviral agents.

abstract_zh: 摘要 蚊媒虫媒病毒,包括登革病毒(登革热病毒,DENV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV),构成日益增长的全球健康负担,但目前大多数此类感染尚无特异性抗病毒药物疗法。此未满足需求凸显了从生物学相关来源(如植物来源天然产物)中识别新型抗病毒药物化合物的重要性。本研究采用生物活性引导方法,对八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行筛选,以发现对Vero细胞中DENV-2具有抗病毒药物活性的化合物。五种提取物显著降低病毒感染性,其中卵叶茄(Solanum ovalifolium)和星叶藤属(Cestrum sp.)在非细胞毒性浓度下实现完全抑制。随后进行分馏和纯化,分离出四种螺甾烷型类固醇皂苷,利用UPLC-DAD-MS和1D/2D NMR光谱进行结构鉴定。功能实验表明,这些化合物抑制DENV复制,表现为病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及传染性病毒滴度显著下降。阶段特异性分析显示,其抗病毒药物活性主要与病毒生命周期的细胞内阶段相关,符合对病毒复制和/或蛋白加工的抑制。分子对接分析支持上述结果,预测这些化合物与关键病毒酶,尤其是NS5 RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶和NS3解旋酶/蛋白酶,形成有利相互作用。重要的是,分离得到的化合物对ZIKV和CHIKV仍保持抗病毒药物活性,表明具备跨虫媒病毒的效力。综上,这些发现将螺甾烷皂苷确定为有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物剂。

analysis_zh.main_results: 四种分离得到的螺甾烷型类固醇皂苷在非细胞毒性浓度下显著降低病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及传染性病毒滴度。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,螺甾烷皂苷抑制DENV复制和蛋白表达,并对多种虫媒病毒显示活性,提示其在广谱抗病毒药物开发中的潜力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为进一步研究螺甾烷皂苷作为抗病毒药物剂提供了基础,可能为登革热及相关虫媒病毒感染的新疗法研发提供参考。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于体外发现,证据强度为中等,因为缺乏体内或临床数据来支持在细胞培养中观察到的抗病毒药物疗效。

title: Integrating machine learning and data-driven modelling: predicting dengue outbreaks and revealing spatially heterogeneous climatic drivers in Brazil.
abstract: Abstract Dengue fever poses a major global health threat, with Brazil experiencing severe recurrent outbreaks driven by climatic, socio-economic and mobility factors. Accurate prediction remains challenging owing to dynamically shifting transmission patterns under intervention. This study employs a physics-informed neural network framework to integrate surveillance data with mechanistic models, inferring time-varying intervention parameters. The model demonstrates a strong capacity to fit state-level data from Brazil. Furthermore, it is used to generate 12-week forecasts for future dengue cases. Given the critical influence of climate on transmission dynamics, we also constructed separate eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) models for individual states using epidemiological and meteorological data. SHapley Additive exPlanation (SHAP) analysis was applied to identify key climatic drivers and reveal significant regional heterogeneity. Our findings reveal that the drivers of the outbreak exhibit regional heterogeneity, and this geographical variation shows a strong correlation with the intensity of human activities and regional economic development levels. These insights into spatial heterogeneity and predictive modelling can inform the design of more effective, regionally tailored public health strategies for dengue control in Brazil.
journal: Journal of the Royal Society, Interface

title_zh: 整合机器学习和数据驱动建模:预测登革热暴发并揭示巴西空间异质性的气候驱动因素
source_body_en: Abstract Dengue fever poses a major global health threat, with Brazil experiencing severe recurrent outbreaks driven by climatic, socio-economic and mobility factors. Accurate prediction remains challenging owing to dynamically shifting transmission patterns under intervention. This study employs a physics-informed neural network framework to integrate surveillance data with mechanistic models, inferring time-varying intervention parameters. The model demonstrates a strong capacity to fit state-level data from Brazil. Furthermore, it is used to generate 12-week forecasts for future dengue cases. Given the critical influence of climate on transmission dynamics, we also constructed separate eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) models for individual states using epidemiological and meteorological data. SHapley Additive exPlanation (SHAP) analysis was applied to identify key climatic drivers and reveal significant regional heterogeneity. Our findings reveal that the drivers of the outbreak exhibit regional heterogeneity, and this geographical variation shows a strong correlation with the intensity of human activities and regional economic development levels. These insights into spatial heterogeneity and predictive modelling can inform the design of more effective, regionally tailored public health strategies for dengue control in Brazil.
abstract_zh: 摘要 登革热 对全球公共卫生构成重大威胁,巴西频繁发生严重的 暴发,其受到气候、社会经济和人口流动因素的驱动。由于干预措施下 传播 模式不断变化,准确预测仍具有挑战性。本研究采用物理信息神经网络框架,将 监测 数据与机制模型相结合,推断随时间变化的干预参数。该模型展现出对巴西州级数据很强的拟合能力。此外,该模型还用于预测未来12周的登革热病例数。鉴于气候对 传播 动态具有关键影响,我们还利用流行病学和气象数据,为各州分别构建了极端梯度提升(XGBoost)模型。采用SHapley加性解释(SHAP)分析来识别关键气候驱动因素,并揭示显著的区域异质性。研究结果表明,暴发 的驱动因素具有区域异质性,而这种地理差异与人类活动强度及区域经济发展水平高度相关。这些关于空间异质性和预测建模的见解,可为巴西制定更有效、因地制宜的登革热防控公共卫生策略提供参考。

title: In silico investigation and identification of potential phytocompounds targeting dengue virus NS5 methyltransferase.
abstract: UNLABELLED: Dengue is an escalating public health threat in warm climate zones, particularly in tropical and subtropical regions. The World Health Organization (WHO) recorded approximately 4 million cases and 3000 deaths in 97 countries between January and July 2025, highlighting the urgent need for effective antiviral therapeutics. The presence of four genetically distinct serotypes of dengue virus (DENV) and the lack of a broadly effective drug pose major challenges for disease control. This study utilized an in silico approach to suggest potential phytocompounds targeting the non-structural protein 5 (NS5) methyltransferase, a crucial protein involved in 5'-mRNA capping. A total of 605 phytocompounds from Allium sativum, Curcuma longa, Camellia sinensis, and Carica papaya were screened based on Lipinski's rule of five and docked against the NS5 methyltransferase protein. Eight compounds exhibited higher predicted binding affinities than the control (-7.648 kcal/mol) with Dehydrocarpaine-I showing the most favorable predicted binding affinities (-9.456 kcal/mol). Top candidates were further evaluated based on their pharmacokinetic properties, toxicity profiles, and the protein-ligand interactions. Molecular dynamics simulations and principal component analysis (PCA) suggested the stability and favorable dynamic behavior of Dehydrocarpaine-I, Theasapogenol-B, and Brassinolide. MM-PBSA calculations showed that Theasapogenol-B (-62.48 kcal/mol) and Brassinolide (-44.82 kcal/mol) exhibited more favorable binding free energies compared to the control (-43.46 kcal/mol). This study suggests Theasapogenol-B and Brassinolide as potential lead compounds targeting NS5 methyltransferase and provides a basis for further comprehensive in silico, in vitro and in vivo validation. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s40203-026-00723-3.

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于计算机模拟方法,可能无法完全反映体外或体内行为。由于依赖于计算模型且未包括实验验证,证据强度中等。

title: Kinetics and specificity of orthoflaviviruses NS1 IgG after Zika virus infection in Yellow fever and dengue immunized individuals: a memory recall hypothesis
abstract: Abstract Pre-existing Orthoflavivirus immunity can shape antibody recall upon infection with a heterologous virus. We monitored Zika virus (ZIKV) infection in individuals vaccinated against yellow fever virus (YFV), with or without prior dengue virus (DENV) exposure. We obtained longitudinal serology data (NS1- and whole-virus IgG responses) and neutralization titers on days 0 and 28 after ZIKV infection. YFV-neutralizing antibody levels remained stable over time, consistent with the long-lasting immunity induced by YFV vaccination. By contrast, ZIKV infection triggered an increase in anti-YFV NS1 IgG, suggesting a selective recall of YFV-specific memory B cells. A similar trend was observed for anti-DENV NS1 IgG exclusively in DENV-immune individuals. Thus, prior Orthoflavivirus exposure shapes the specificity and magnitude of NS1-directed humoral recall, with implications for serological interpretation.

title: The Application of RNAscope Protocol to Detect Dengue Virus in Human Paraffin-Embedded Tissue.
abstract: Dengue is an important arthropod-borne viral disease, endemic in over 100 countries and challenging health care systems worldwide São Paulo, Brasil. The disease can be clinically diagnosed by the detection of dengue-specific antibodies, nonstructural 1 antigen, or viral RNA by reverse transcriptase-polymerase chain reaction São Paulo, Brasil. When there is an indication to perform a biopsy or in cases of retrospective studies using material from necropsy, immunohistochemistry is an efficient tool. Recently, RNAscope has emerged as a new generation of in situ hybridization technique, with the advantage of different probes, including a probe to Dengue virus. This paper aimed to analyze the use of the RNAscope technique as a supplementary method, compared to immunohistochemistry, for the evaluation of dengue virus in human specimens. An immunohistochemical and molecular study was conducted in pulmonary and renal tissues from individuals who died due to severe dengue, selected according to clinical and serological diagnosis. The immunohistochemical assay was performed using a monoclonal anti-dengue virus antibody. Positivity was visualized in the cytoplasm of mononuclear cells in the interalveolar septal region and also in glomeruli and tubules. RNAscope was performed using a probe to dengue type 2. It was possible to visualize the positivity as small dots or clusters in the same area in the lungs and tubules in the kidney specimen. The finding of dots or clusters through the RNAscope protocol could suggest viral replication; however, only the finding of replicative intermediates or cultures would confirm such activity.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the use of RNAscope for detecting dengue virus in human tissues, addressing the need for supplementary methods in diagnosing dengue, particularly in severe cases.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved analyzing pulmonary and renal tissues from individuals who died due to severe dengue, selected based on clinical and serological diagnosis, in São Paulo, Brasil.
analysis.methods: Immunohistochemistry was performed using a monoclonal anti-dengue virus antibody, while RNAscope utilized a probe specific to dengue type 2.
analysis.main_results: RNAscope detected dengue virus in the cytoplasm of mononuclear cells in the interalveolar septal region and in glomeruli and tubules, while immunohistochemistry showed positivity in the same areas.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrated the potential of RNAscope as a supplementary method for detecting dengue virus in human tissues, offering a new approach to confirm viral presence.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that RNAscope can be used to identify dengue virus in tissues, aiding in the diagnosis and understanding of severe dengue cases.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the use of a specific dengue type 2 probe and the retrospective nature of the tissue samples, which may affect generalizability.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated RNAscope for detecting dengue virus in human tissues from severe dengue cases in São Paulo, Brasil, demonstrating its potential as a supplementary method.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the use of RNAscope for detecting dengue virus in human tissues, addressing the need for supplementary methods in diagnosing dengue, particularly in severe cases.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved analyzing pulmonary and renal tissues from individuals who died due to severe dengue, selected based on clinical and serological diagnosis, in São Paulo, Brasil.
analysis_en.methods: Immunohistochemistry was performed using a monoclonal anti-dengue virus antibody, while RNAscope utilized a probe specific to dengue type 2.
analysis_en.main_results: RNAscope detected dengue virus in the cytoplasm of mononuclear cells in the interalveolar septal region and in glomeruli and tubules, while immunohistochemistry showed positivity in the same areas.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrated the potential of RNAscope as a supplementary method for detecting dengue virus in human tissues, offering a new approach to confirm viral presence.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that RNAscope can be used to identify dengue virus in tissues, aiding in the diagnosis and understanding of severe dengue cases.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the use of a specific dengue type 2 probe and the retrospective nature of the tissue samples, which may affect generalizability.

title_zh: RNAscope技术在检测人类石蜡包埋组织中登革病毒的应用
source_body_en: Dengue is an important arthropod-borne viral disease, endemic in over 100 countries and challenging health care systems worldwide São Paulo, Brasil. The disease can be clinically diagnosed by the detection of dengue-specific antibodies, nonstructural 1 antigen, or viral RNA by reverse transcriptase-polymerase chain reaction São Paulo, Brasil. When there is an indication to perform a biopsy or in cases of retrospective studies using material from necropsy, immunohistochemistry is an efficient tool. Recently, RNAscope has emerged as a new generation of in situ hybridization technique, with the advantage of different probes, including a probe to Dengue virus. This paper aimed to analyze the use of the RNAscope technique as a supplementary method, compared to immunohistochemistry, for the evaluation of dengue virus in human specimens. An immunohistochemical and molecular study was conducted in pulmonary and renal tissues from individuals who died due to severe dengue, selected according to clinical and serological diagnosis. The immunohistochemical assay was performed using a monoclonal anti-dengue virus antibody. Positivity was visualized in the cytoplasm of mononuclear cells in the interalveolar septal region and also in glomeruli and tubules. RNAscope was performed using a probe to dengue type 2. It was possible to visualize the positivity as small dots or clusters in the same area in the lungs and tubules in the kidney specimen. The finding of dots or clusters through the RNAscope protocol could suggest viral replication; however, only the finding of replicative intermediates or cultures would confirm such activity.
abstract_zh: 登革热是一种重要的虫媒病毒性疾病,流行于超过100个国家,并对全球卫生系统构成挑战。在巴西圣保罗,该疾病可通过检测登革热特异性抗体、非结构蛋白1抗原或病毒RNA来实现临床诊断。当需要进行活检或在回顾性研究中使用尸检材料时,免疫组化是一种有效的工具。最近,RNAscope作为一种新一代的原位杂交技术崭露头角,其优势在于使用多种探针,包括针对登革病毒的探针。本文旨在分析RNAscope技术作为免疫组化补充方法在人类样本中检测登革病毒的潜力。在巴西圣保罗,对因重症登革热死亡的个体的肺部和肾脏组织进行了免疫组化和分子学研究,这些样本根据临床和血清学诊断进行选择。免疫组化检测使用了单克隆抗登革病毒抗体,阳性结果在肺泡间隔区的单核细胞胞浆中以及肾小球和肾小管中可见。RNAscope检测使用了针对登革病毒2型的探针,能够在肺部和肾脏样本的相同区域中观察到小点或簇状的阳性信号。通过RNAscope协议检测到的点或簇可能提示病毒复制,但只有检测到复制中间体或培养结果才能确认这种活动。

title: Decoding Functional Plasticity of γδ T Cells in Mosquito-Borne Diseases.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Mosquito‐borne diseases (MBDs), caused by pathogens including dengue virus (DENV), West Nile virus (WNV), Zika virus (ZIKV), chikungunya virus (CHIKV) and "Plasmodium" species, pose a major global health threat with limited effective interventions. As a distinctive T‐cell subset, γδ T cells exert crucial immunoregulatory functions during infection owing to their unique tissue distribution and functional plasticity, yet their roles in MBDs remain incompletely understood. OBJECTIVES: This review summarizes the immunoregulatory mechanisms of γδ T cells in MBDs and discusses their potential as immunotherapeutic targets. METHODS: A systematic literature search was performed in PubMed using keywords such as "γδ T cells", "Plasmodium", "dengue virus" and "Zika virus". Relevant publications up to March 2026 were comprehensively reviewed. RESULTS: γδ T cells display dual protective and pathogenic effects across MBDs. They mainly confer protection against Plasmodium and CHIKV infections, while drive pathological responses in DENV and ZIKV infections. The central question is to explore the immunoregulatory mechanisms of γδ T cells in DENV infections and their potential as immunotherapeutic targets.

analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that the roles of γδ T cells in MBDs remain incompletely understood, with conflicting findings on their protective or pathogenic effects depending on the specific disease. analysis.summary_en: This review explores the immunoregulatory functions of γδ T cells in dengue virus (DENV) infections and their potential as therapeutic targets. It highlights the dual protective and pathogenic effects of γδ T cells across mosquito-borne diseases (MBDs), with specific emphasis on their roles in DENV. The review conducted a systematic search of PubMed up to March 2026, identifying conflicting findings on γδ T cell behavior in different MBDs. While γδ T cells are primarily protective against Plasmodium and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), they drive pathological responses in DENV and Zika virus (ZIKV) infections. In West Nile virus (WNV) infection, γδ T cells activate immune cells but also induce blood-brain barrier damage. The review underscores the need for further research to understand the functional plasticity of γδ T cells in DENV and to develop targeted immunotherapies.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述通过PubMed使用关键词如"γδ T细胞"、"Plasmodium"、"登革病毒"和"寨卡病毒"进行系统文献检索,全面回顾了截至2026年3月的相关文献。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: γδ T细胞在蚊媒疾病(MBDs)中表现出双重保护和致病效应。它们主要对Plasmodium和CHIKV感染提供保护,而在DENV和ZIKV感染中则驱动病理反应。在WNV感染中,γδ T细胞激活免疫细胞,同时导致血脑屏障损伤。阐明其功能可塑性可能为开发针对蚊媒疾病的靶向免疫治疗提供见解。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,γδ T细胞在蚊媒疾病中的作用仍不完全明确,其保护或致病效应因具体疾病而异,存在矛盾的发现。在登革病毒感染中,γδ T细胞的功能可塑性尚未完全阐明,需要更详细的研究来探讨其机制。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要进一步研究以明确γδ T细胞在登革病毒感染中的双重作用,并探索其作为免疫治疗靶点的潜力。这包括对其功能可塑性以及其如何在保护和病理反应中发挥作用的具体机制进行研究。

title: Future dengue outbreak risk in Guangzhou under climate change: a mechanistic projection coupling temperature- dependent vector competence with reanalysis and CMIP6 meteorology
abstract: Abstract Background Dengue transmission in southern China depends on the temperature-sensitive extrinsic incubation period (EIP) of dengue virus in Aedes albopictus. Warming is expected to change both the length of the transmission season and the time available for public-health response after an imported case. We quantified these changes mechanistically for Guangzhou. Methods We drove a temperature-forced vector-competence model with daily ERA5 reanalysis (2015–2022) across Guangzhou and projected it under a bias-corrected multi-model CMIP6 ensemble (seven models, 2041–2050 relative to 1995–2014). EIP and the basic reproduction number R0 were computed from established enzyme-kinetics and next-generation-matrix formulations. The response window, defined as EIP plus the human viremic period, was used as the actionable lead time for control. Results Under the current climate, competent transmission (R0 > 1) spans March to November, with a mean transmission season of 33.6 weeks and a July EIP minimum of 3.7 days. By the near-2050s (7-model ensemble, about + 1.2 degC), the season lengthens to 36.4 weeks (+ 8%) and the July EIP falls to 2.2 days. Under a high-warming + 2.3 degC envelope it reaches 39.6 weeks (+ 18%) with a July EIP of 1.6 days. The mean response window inside competent months compresses by 7.8 days (near-2050s) and 12.2 days (high-warming). Sensitivity analysis shows the season length rises monotonically with warming, reaching 40.7 weeks at + 3.0 degC. Conclusions Warming has a two-sided effect on Guangzhou dengue risk. The transmission season lengthens, widening the annual exposure window, while the peak-summer response window shortens, compressing the time available to interrupt local spread after an imported case. Both shifts support climate-responsive, EIP-informed early warning and vector-control scheduling.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess how climate change will affect dengue transmission in Guangzhou by examining the temperature-sensitive extrinsic incubation period (EIP) of dengue virus in Aedes albopictus. Warming is expected to alter both the length of the transmission season and the time available for public-health response after an imported case.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used a mechanistic projection model to quantify changes in dengue transmission for Guangzhou, incorporating daily ERA5 reanalysis data from 2015–2022 and projecting it under a bias-corrected multi-model CMIP6 ensemble for the near-2050s and high-warming scenarios. The model focused on the transmission season and response window.
analysis.methods: The researchers developed a temperature-forced vector-competence model, using established enzyme-kinetics and next-generation-matrix formulations to compute the EIP and basic reproduction number R0. They applied this model to daily ERA5 reanalysis data across Guangzhou and projected it under a bias-corrected multi-model CMIP6 ensemble for the near-2050s and high-warming scenarios.
analysis.main_results: Under the current climate, competent transmission (R0 > 1) spans March to November, with a mean transmission season of 33.6 weeks and a July EIP minimum of 3.7 days. By the near-2050s, the season lengthens to 36.4 weeks (+ 8%) and the July EIP falls to 2.2 days. Under a high-warming + 2.3 degC envelope, the season reaches 39.6 weeks (+ 18%) with a July EIP of 1.6 days. The mean response window inside competent months compresses by 7.8 days (near-2050s) and 12.2 days (high-warming).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that warming has a two-sided effect on Guangzhou dengue risk, with the transmission season lengthening and the peak-summer response window shortening. This shift supports the development of climate-responsive, EIP-informed early warning systems and vector-control scheduling.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform climate-responsive public health strategies, such as early warning systems and vector-control scheduling, by highlighting the changes in the transmission season and response window due to warming. These insights are crucial for preparing for future dengue outbreaks in Guangzhou.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on mechanistic projections using reanalysis and CMIP6 meteorology, which may have limitations in capturing real-world complexities. The evidence is moderate, as it relies on model-based assumptions and does not account for all variables affecting dengue transmission.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the impact of climate change on dengue outbreak risk in Guangzhou by analyzing the temperature-dependent extrinsic incubation period (EIP) of dengue virus in Aedes albopictus. Using ERA5 reanalysis data and CMIP6 projections, the researchers found that the transmission season lengthens under warming scenarios, while the response window shortens. These findings suggest that climate-responsive, EIP-informed early warning systems and vector-control strategies are essential for managing future dengue outbreaks. The study provides valuable insights for public health planning but is limited by its reliance on model-based assumptions.

title_zh: 未来广州登革热风险在气候变化下的机制性预测:耦合温度依赖的登革病毒在白纹伊蚊中的潜伏期与再分析和CMIP6气象学的投影研究
source_body_en: Abstract Background Dengue transmission in southern China depends on the temperature-sensitive extrinsic incubation period (EIP) of dengue virus in Aedes albopictus. Warming is expected to change both the length of the transmission season and the time available for public-health response after an imported case. We quantified these changes mechanistically for Guangzhou. Methods We drove a temperature-forced vector-competence model with daily ERA5 reanalysis (2015–2022) across Guangzhou and projected it under a bias-corrected multi-model CMIP6 ensemble (seven models, 2041–2050 relative to 1995–2014). EIP and the basic reproduction number R0 were computed from established enzyme-kinetics and next-generation-matrix formulations. The response window, defined as EIP plus the human viremic period, was used as the actionable lead time for control. Results Under the current climate, competent transmission (R0 > 1) spans March to November, with a mean transmission season of 33.6 weeks and a July EIP minimum of 3.7 days. By the near-2050s (7-model ensemble, about + 1.2 degC), the season lengthens to 36.4 weeks (+ 8%) and the July EIP falls to 2.2 days. Under a high-warming + 2.3 degC envelope it reaches 39.6 weeks (+ 18%) with a July EIP of 1.6 days. The mean response window inside competent months compresses by 7.8 days (near-2050s) and 12.2 days (high-warming). Sensitivity analysis shows the season length rises monotonically with warming, reaching 40.7 weeks at + 3.0 degC. Conclusions Warming has a two-sided effect on Guangzhou dengue risk. The transmission season lengthens, widening the annual exposure window, while the peak-summer response window shortens, compressing the time available to interrupt local spread after an imported case. Both shifts support climate-responsive, EIP-informed early warning and vector-control scheduling.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 南方中国的登革热传播取决于埃及伊蚊 (Aedes albopictus) 中温度敏感的外部孵育期 (EIP) 的登革病毒。气候变暖预计会改变传播季节的长度以及进口病例后公共卫生响应的可用时间。我们在广州对这些变化进行了机制性量化。方法 我们使用2015–2022年广州地区的每日ERA5再分析数据驱动温度强迫的媒介-适应模型,并在偏差校正的多模型CMIP6集合(七个模型,2041–2050相对于1995–2014)下进行投影。依据已建立的酶动力学和下一代矩阵公式计算EIP和基本再生数R0。将响应窗口定义为EIP加上人类病毒血症期,作为可操作的控制提前时间。结果 在当前气候下,适宜的传播(R0>1)范围为3月至11月,平均传播季节为33.6周,7月EIP最短为3.7天。至近2050年代(七模型集合,约+1.2°C),季节延长至36.4周(+8%),7月EIP降至2.2天。高温情景(+2.3°C)下,季节达39.6周(+18%),7月EIP为1.6天。适宜月份内的平均响应窗口分别缩短7.8天(近2050年代)和12.2天(高温情景)。敏感性分析显示,季节长度随升温单调增加,在+3.0°C时达到40.7周。结论 气候变暖对广州登革热风险产生双重影响。传播季节延长,扩大全年暴露窗口;而夏季高峰期的响应窗口缩短,压缩了进口病例后阻断本地传播的时间。这两种变化均支持基于气候响应、EIP信息的早期预警和媒介控制调度。

title: Fatal Infection with Dengue Virus and Avian Orthoavulavirus 1 in Traveler Returning from Saudi Arabia to France, 2025.
abstract: A previously healthy 26-year-old man died of hemorrhagic fever with fulminant hepatitis and shock 36 hours after returning to France from Mecca, Saudi Arabia. Postmortem analyses detected low-level dengue virus RNA and positive NS1 antigen along with unexpected extremely high-titer disseminated velogenic avian orthoavulavirus 1 infection with elevated systemic cytokine responses.

source_body_en: A previously healthy 26-year-old man died of hemorrhagic fever with fulminant hepatitis and shock 36 hours after returning to France from Mecca, Saudi Arabia. title: Biopsy-proven dengue virus-associated IgA nephropathy and interstitial nephritis with viral RNA detected in kidney tissue.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue virus infection can cause kidney involvement, but biopsy-confirmed cases with both glomerular and tubulointerstitial lesions and molecular evidence of viral presence are rare. CASE PRESENTATION: A previously healthy 34-year-old man developed fever and dark urine after returning from Vietnam. He presented with acute kidney injury, nephrotic-range proteinuria, hematuria, and elevated aminotransferases. Kidney biopsy revealed IgA nephropathy (Oxford M1E0S0T0C0) with acute interstitial nephritis and granulomatous inflammation. Dengue virus serotype 2 RNA was detected in blood and renal tissue by tNGS. With supportive treatment, renal function, proteinuria, and hematuria completely resolved within one month. CONCLUSION: Dengue infection may trigger concurrent glomerular and tubulointerstitial immune-mediated kidney injury. Molecular detection of viral RNA in renal tissue provides evidence of renal involvement.

title: Immune-driven serotype-specific evolution of dengue virus NS1: Insights from structural and epitope analyses of Indian isolates.
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Despite the diagnostic and immunological importance of NS1, how evolutionary forces shapes NS1 evolution across different serotypes of dengue remain poorly understood. METHODS: NS1 sequences representing all four dengue virus serotypes were analyzed for haplotype diversity and selection pressure using codon-based models. Positively selected sites were structurally mapped onto dimeric, tetrameric and hexameric NS1 conformations. Diversifying sites were also overlapped with predicted B-cell epitopes. Structural mapping of selected sites was done on NS1-antbody structure. Minimum heavy atom distance was calculated of those sites from antibody-binding site and predicted affinity change (ΔΔG) was also calculated. RESULTS: Haplotype frequency analysis showed high haplotype diversity and multiple co-circulating variants in DENV-2, moderate haplotype diversity in DENV-1 and 3, whereas DENV-4 showed lowest diversity. Selection pressure analyses identified several positively selected residues, predominantly localized within the wing and β-ladder domains. These sites also overlapped with some conserved predicted B-cell epitopes. Notably, none of the positively selected residues directly overlapped with the antigen-antibody binding interface and were associated with minimal predicted changes in binding affinity. DISCUSSION: Our results indicate that NS1 evolution reflects strong functional constraint with localized, serotype-specific variation, underscoring the relevance of continued NS1 sequence monitoring for diagnostic robustness and the potential utility of conserved regions in vaccine design.
journal: Infection, genetics and evolution : journal of molecular epidemiology and evolutionary genetics in infectious diseases

NS1 sequences representing all four dengue virus serotypes were analyzed for haplotype diversity and selection pressure using codon-based models. Positively selected sites were structurally mapped onto dimeric, tetrameric and hexameric NS1 conformations. Diversifying sites were also overlapped with predicted B-cell epitopes. Structural mapping of selected sites was done on NS1-antbody structure. Minimum heavy atom distance was calculated of those sites from antibody-binding site and predicted affinity change (ΔΔG) was also calculated. Haplotype frequency analysis showed high haplotype diversity and multiple co-circulating variants in DENV-2, moderate haplotype diversity in DENV-1 and 3, whereas DENV-4 showed lowest diversity. Selection pressure analyses identified several positively selected residues, predominantly localized within the wing and β-ladder domains. These sites also overlapped with some conserved predicted B-cell epitopes. Notably, none of the positively selected residues directly overlapped with the antigen-antibody binding interface and were associated with minimal predicted changes in binding affinity. Our results indicate that NS1 evolution reflects strong functional constraint with localized, serotype-specific variation, underscoring the relevance of continued NS1 sequence monitoring for diagnostic robustness and the potential utility of conserved regions in vaccine design.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate how evolutionary forces shape the NS1 protein of dengue virus across different serotypes, as the role of NS1 in diagnosis and immunity is well recognized but its evolutionary dynamics remain unclear.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed NS1 sequences from all four dengue virus serotypes, focusing on haplotype diversity and selection pressure using codon-based models. It included Indian isolates and examined structural and epitope features of the NS1 protein.
analysis.methods: NS1 sequences were analyzed for haplotype diversity and selection pressure using codon-based models. Positively selected sites were mapped onto dimeric, tetrameric, and hexameric NS1 conformations. Diversifying sites were overlapped with predicted B-cell epitopes, and structural mapping was performed on NS1-antibody complexes. Minimum heavy atom distances from antibody-binding sites and predicted affinity changes (ΔΔG) were calculated.
analysis.main_results: Haplotype frequency analysis revealed high diversity in DENV-2, moderate diversity in DENV-1 and DENV-3, and the lowest diversity in DENV-4. Selection pressure analyses identified several positively selected residues, mainly in the wing and β-ladder domains. These sites overlapped with some conserved predicted B-cell epitopes. Notably, none of the positively selected residues overlapped with the antigen-antibody binding interface, and they were associated with minimal predicted changes in binding affinity.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that NS1 evolution is subject to strong functional constraints with localized, serotype-specific variations. This highlights the importance of continued NS1 sequence monitoring for diagnostic accuracy and the potential use of conserved regions in vaccine development.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide insights into the evolutionary dynamics of NS1, which can inform the development of more robust diagnostic tools and vaccines. They also emphasize the need for ongoing surveillance of NS1 diversity to improve public health responses to dengue.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on Indian isolates, which may not represent global dengue virus diversity. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the reliance on predicted epitopes and structural models rather than experimental validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the evolutionary dynamics of the NS1 protein in dengue virus across four serotypes, emphasizing the role of immune-driven selection in shaping its structure. Using codon-based models, the researchers identified haplotype diversity and positively selected residues, particularly in the wing and β-ladder domains. These sites were mapped onto NS1 conformations and overlapped with conserved B-cell epitopes, though none directly interacted with the antibody-binding interface. The findings suggest that NS1 evolution is constrained by functional requirements, with serotype-specific variations. This has implications for improving diagnostic accuracy and vaccine design by focusing on conserved regions. However, the study's reliance on Indian isolates and predicted epitopes limits its generalizability, resulting in moderate confidence in the conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨进化力量如何塑造不同登革病毒型的NS1蛋白,因为NS1在登革热和免疫中的作用已被广泛认可,但其进化动态仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了所有四种登革病毒型的NS1序列,重点使用密码子模型研究单倍型多样性和选择压力。研究包括印度分离株,并检查了NS1蛋白的结构和表位特征。
elements_zh.methods: 使用密码子模型分析了NS1序列的单倍型多样性和选择压力。正向选择位点被映射到二聚体、四聚体和六聚体NS1构象上。多样化位点与预测的B细胞表位重叠,并对NS1-抗体复合物进行了结构映射。计算了这些位点与抗体结合位点之间的最小重原子距离以及预测的亲和力变化(ΔΔG)。
elements_zh.main_results: 单倍型频率分析显示,DENV-2具有高多样性,DENV-1和DENV-3具有中等多样性,而DENV-4则显示出最低的多样性。选择压力分析确定了多个正向选择残基,主要位于翼状结构域和β梯结构域内。这些位点与一些保守的预测B细胞表位重叠。值得注意的是,正向选择残基并未与抗原-抗体结合界面重叠,并且与结合亲和力的最小预测变化相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,NS1 进化受到强烈的函数约束,具有局部化的、型特异性的变异。这突显了持续监测NS1序列以确保诊断准确性和利用保守区域进行疫苗开发的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了关于NS1进化动态的见解,有助于开发更稳健的诊断工具和疫苗。它们还强调了持续监测NS1多样性以改善登革热公共卫生应对措施的必要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其仅关注印度分离株,这可能无法代表全球登革病毒的多样性。由于依赖于预测的表位和结构模型而非实验验证,证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 目的:尽管NS1在诊断和免疫学中具有重要意义,但如何进化力量塑造不同登革病毒型的NS1 进化仍不明确。方法:使用密码子模型分析了代表所有四种登革病毒型的NS1序列,以研究单倍型多样性及选择压力。正向选择位点被映射到二聚体、四聚体和六聚体NS1构象上。多样化位点也与预测的B细胞表位重叠。选择了NS1-抗体复合物的结构映射,并计算了这些位点与抗体结合位点之间的最小重原子距离以及预测的亲和力变化(ΔΔG)。结果:单倍型频率分析显示,DENV-2具有高单倍型多样性且存在多种共循环变异体,DENV-1和DENV-3具有中等单倍型多样性,而DENV-4则显示出最低的多样性。选择压力分析确定了多个正向选择残基,主要位于翼状结构域和β梯结构域内。这些位点也与一些保守的预测B细胞表位重叠。值得注意的是,正向选择残基并未直接与抗原-抗体结合界面重叠,并且与结合亲和力的最小预测变化相关。讨论:我们的结果表明,NS1 进化受到强烈的功能约束,具有局部化的、型特异性的变异,强调了持续监测NS1序列以确保诊断准确性和利用保守区域进行疫苗设计的潜在价值。科学与公共卫生意义:这些结果提供了关于NS1进化动态的见解,有助于开发更稳健的诊断工具和疫苗。它们还强调了持续监测NS1多样性以改善登革热公共卫生应对措施的必要性。局限性与证据强度:本研究的局限性在于其仅关注印度分离株,这可能无法代表全球登革病毒的多样性。由于依赖于预测的表位和结构模型而非实验验证,证据强度中等。

title: Phylogenetic analysis reveals cocirculation genotype of all four dengue virus serotypes in Thailand.
abstract: Dengue fever is a hyperendemic disease in Thailand caused by four distinct dengue virus serotypes (DENV-1 to 4) that co-circulate annually. Fluctuating endemic patterns make it difficult to predict outbreaks in hyperendemic regions. Additionally, the envelope protein is associated with cocirculation of several serotypes, cocirculation of different strains within the same genotype, and heterotypic dengue infection. To control dengue epidemiology, phylogenetic analysis of envelope gene sequences and geographic distribution should be conducted. In this report, we characterized 305 dengue envelope genes isolated from blood samples of dengue-infected Thai patients from 1999 to 2012. Phylogenetic tree analysis of the envelope gene nucleotide sequences of 305 strains revealed that they comprised 128 strains of DENV-1, classified as genotype I; 56 strains of DENV-2, classified as Asian I and cosmopolitan genotypes; 56 strains of DENV-3, classified as genotypes I, II, and III; and 65 strains of DENV-4, classified as genotypes I and II. The results attributed DENV-1 to 4 to distinct locations in Thailand, with recurrent circulation in the original region for similar periods. In addition, DENV-1 genotype I was the main strain circulating almost annually between 1999 and 2012, whereas DENV-2 Asian I was the predominant genotype isolated between 2010 and 2012. Taken together, all four serotypes may have co-circulated in Thailand from 1999 to 2012. DENV-1 to 4 were particularly homogeneous circulating genotypes. Therefore, the molecular diversity of the dengue envelope gene has been co-circulating in Thailand for over a decade.
journal: Infection, genetics and evolution : journal of molecular epidemiology and evolutionary genetics in infectious diseases

abstract_zh: 登革热是一种在泰国高度流行的疾病,由四种不同的登革病毒血清型(DENV-1至DENV-4)每年同时流行引起。波动的流行模式使得在高度流行地区预测暴发变得困难。此外,包膜蛋白与多种血清型同时流行、同一基因型内不同株系同时流行以及异型登革热感染有关。为了控制登革热流行病学,应进行登革热包膜基因序列的系统发育分析及其地理分布研究。本报告对1999年至2012年间泰国登革热感染患者血液样本中分离的305个登革热包膜基因进行了特征分析。对305株包膜基因核苷酸序列的系统发育树分析显示,这些基因包括128株DENV-1,归类为基因型I;56株DENV-2,归类为亚洲I型和全球型基因型;56株DENV-3,归类为基因型I、II和III;以及65株DENV-4,归类为基因型I和II。结果表明,DENV-1至DENV-4分别对应泰国不同的地区,并在原地区反复流行,持续时间相似。此外,DENV-1基因型I几乎每年都在泰国流行,而DENV-2亚洲I型则在2010年至2012年间为主要分离的基因型。综上所述,从1999年至2012年,泰国可能同时流行了四种血清型。DENV-1至DENV-4均为特别同质的流行基因型。因此,登革热包膜基因的分子多样性已在泰国持续流行十多年。

abstract: Abstract Togo experienced its first nationally reported dengue outbreak in 2024 amid a broader resurgence of dengue across Africa. Data on serotype distribution, genomic diversity, and transmission dynamics in the region were limited. Here, we integrated epidemiological, genomic, and environmental analyses to characterize the origins and spread of dengue transmission in Togo. title: Mean elevation of inhabited areas reveals that coarse district-level analyses overestimate the altitudinal shift of dengue in Nepal.
abstract: The potential altitudinal expansion of dengue fever under climate change has received increasing attention. In Nepal, rising dengue incidence across all districts has been interpreted as evidence of spread into higher elevations. However, such conclusions are often based on district-level aggregated data, which can misrepresent transmission patterns in a highly heterogeneous mountainous landscape. District mean elevation frequently includes extensive uninhabited high-altitude areas, leading to overestimation of the elevation at which dengue transmission occurs. We combined Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) elevation data with gridded population datasets to derive mean elevation of inhabited area, providing a more realistic proxy of inhabited environments. District-level dengue data (2006-2025) were analyzed using both conventional mean elevation and population-weighted metrics. Substantial discrepancies were observed between these measures. For example, Kaski District shifts from 2,608 m (rank 19) to 987 m (rank 49) when population weighting is applied. Overall, population distribution is strongly concentrated in river valleys at lower elevations, with a sharp decline above 2,000 m. When population distribution is accounted for, the apparent expansion of dengue into high-elevation districts is markedly reduced indicating previously reported altitudinal shifts of dengue in Nepal may be partly driven by methodological artifacts of coarse spatial aggregation. Our results highlight a critical methodological issue in analyzing climate-sensitive diseases in mountainous settings and suggest that population-weighted approaches provide a more accurate representation of exposure and hence should be prioritized.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed district-level dengue data from 2006 to 2025 in Nepal, focusing on how conventional mean elevation metrics may misrepresent dengue transmission patterns in a mountainous and heterogeneous landscape.
analysis.methods: The researchers combined Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) elevation data with gridded population datasets to calculate the mean elevation of inhabited areas, contrasting this with conventional district-level mean elevation metrics.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the potential altitudinal expansion of dengue fever in Nepal under climate change, highlighting that conventional district-level mean elevation metrics may overestimate the elevation at which dengue transmission occurs. By combining Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) elevation data with gridded population datasets, the researchers derived a more realistic proxy of inhabited environments. They found substantial discrepancies between conventional and population-weighted elevation metrics, with Kaski District shifting from 2,608 m (rank 19) to 987 m (rank 49) when population weighting was applied. These results suggest that previously reported altitudinal shifts may be influenced by methodological artifacts of coarse spatial aggregation. The study emphasizes the importance of using population-weighted approaches to better understand dengue transmission dynamics in mountainous regions, which could improve surveillance and risk assessment strategies. However, the evidence is limited to abstract-level data, and the findings should be interpreted with moderate confidence due to the lack of detailed statistical analyses.

title_zh: 居民区平均海拔高度揭示尼泊尔登革热海拔变化的粗略区级分析高估了其海拔迁移幅度。
source_body_en: The potential altitudinal expansion of dengue fever under climate change has received increasing attention. In Nepal, rising dengue incidence across all districts has been interpreted as evidence of spread into higher elevations. However, such conclusions are often based on district-level aggregated data, which can misrepresent transmission patterns in a highly heterogeneous mountainous landscape. District mean elevation frequently includes extensive uninhabited high-altitude areas, leading to overestimation of the elevation at which dengue transmission occurs. We combined Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) elevation data with gridded population datasets to derive mean elevation of inhabited area, providing a more realistic proxy of inhabited environments. District-level dengue data (2006-2025) were analyzed using both conventional mean elevation and population-weighted metrics. Substantial discrepancies were observed between these measures. For example, Kaski District shifts from 2,608 m (rank 19) to 987 m (rank 49) when population weighting is applied. Overall, population distribution is strongly concentrated in river valleys at lower elevations, with a sharp decline above 2,000 m. When population distribution is accounted for, the apparent expansion of dengue into high-elevation districts is markedly reduced indicating previously reported altitudinal shifts of dengue in Nepal may be partly driven by methodological artifacts of coarse spatial aggregation. Our results highlight a critical methodological issue in analyzing climate-sensitive diseases in mountainous settings and suggest that population-weighted approaches provide a more accurate representation of exposure and hence should be prioritized.
abstract_zh: 登革热在气候变化下的潜在海拔扩展引起了越来越多的关注。在尼泊尔,所有地区的登革热发病率上升已被视为向高海拔地区扩展的证据。然而,这样的结论通常基于区级汇总数据,这可能会在高度异质性的山地景观中误导传播模式。区级平均海拔经常包括大量的无人居住的高海拔地区,导致低估了登革热传播发生的海拔高度。我们结合了SRTM高程数据与网格化人口数据,推导出居住区的平均海拔,提供了更现实的居住环境的代理。分析了2006年至2025年的区级登革热数据(包括传统平均海拔和人口加权指标)。这些指标之间存在显著差异。例如,当应用人口加权时,卡斯克区从2608米(第19位)变为987米(第49位)。总体而言,人口分布集中在低海拔的河谷地带,2000米以上地区人口急剧下降。当考虑人口分布时,登革热向高海拔区扩展的表观扩展明显减少,表明尼泊尔之前报道的登革热海拔变化部分可能是由于粗略空间聚合方法学上的缺陷。我们的结果突显了在山地环境中分析气候敏感疾病时的一个关键方法学问题,并建议应优先考虑人口加权方法以提供更准确的暴露代表。

title: Association of NS1 Antigen, IgM/IgG Antibodies with Haematological Indices and Inflammatory Markers in Suspected Dengue Cases: A Cross-sectional Study
abstract: Introduction: Dengue Virus (DENV) has been re-emerging as a major public health challenge in tropical and subtropical regions, including India, with increasing incidence, changing epidemiology, and seasonal outbreaks. Early diagnosis supported by laboratory markers is essential for effective clinical management and disease control. Aim: To evaluate the association of serological markers with haematological, biochemical and inflammatory parameters in clinically suspected cases of dengue. Materials and Methods: This cross-sectional study was conducted from March 2025 to December 2025 at Adarsh Multispecialty Hospital, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India. The study included 154 patients presenting with Acute Febrile Illness (AFI). DENV diagnosis was performed using an immunochromatographic kit for NS1 antigen and IgM and IgG antibodies from the serum sample. Haematological indices, Inflammation markers and liver function tests Serum Glutamic Pyruvic Transaminase (SGPT) and Serum Glutamic Oxaloacetic Transaminase (SGOT) were examined. Chi-square test was used for statistical analysis, and a p-value of <0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results: A total of 154 suspected Dengue Fever (DF) samples were collected, out of which 38 cases of dengue infection were confirmed. The highest positivity was seen in the age group of 21 to 30 years, 14 (36.8%), with males being more affected, making up 24 (63.2%) of the cases. The seasonal peaks happened during August and September, with 11/34 (32.4%) and 11/42 (26.2%) of cases, respectively. Testing for the NS1 antigen alone found 17/74 (23%) of infections, but combining NS1 and antibody testing raised the rate to about 20/73 (27.3%). Dengue patients showed significantly decreased platelet counts 35/38 (92.1%), White Blood Cell (WBC) counts 21/38 (55.26%), and also lymphocyte counts 20/38 (52.63%). Liver enzymes were also elevated (SGOT 161.58±372.44 U/L and SGPT 187.46±456.09 U/L). They also showed raised C-Reactive Protein (CRP) in 33/38 (86.8%) of cases and higher Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR) in 23/38 (60.5%) of cases. Conclusion: Detection of the NS1 antigen with antibody testing gives more specific results. Significant increase in CRP levels and a drop in platelet levels in dengue-positive patients are early indicators of presumptive diagnosis. Integrated haematological, and inflammatory markers facilitate efficient risk stratification and enhance early dengue identification, enabling prompt clinical therapy during periods of peak transmission.

Chi-square test was used for statistical analysis, and a p-value of <0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results: A total of 154 suspected Dengue Fever (DF) samples were collected, out of which 38 cases of dengue infection were confirmed. The highest positivity was seen in the age group of 21 to 30 years, 14 (36.8%), with males being more affected, making up 24 (63.2%) of the cases. The seasonal peaks happened during August and September, with 11/34 (32.4%) and 11/42 (26.2%) of cases, respectively. Testing for the NS1 antigen alone found 17/74 (23%) of infections, but combining NS1 and antibody testing raised the rate to about 20/73 (27.3%). Dengue patients showed significantly decreased platelet counts 35/38 (92.1%), White Blood Cell (WBC) counts 21/38 (55.26%), and also lymphocyte counts 20/38 (52.63%). Liver enzymes were also elevated (SGOT 161.58±372.44 U/L and SGPT 187.46±456.09 U/L). They also showed raised C-Reactive Protein (CRP) in 33/38 (86.8%) of cases and higher Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR) in 23/38 (60.5%) of cases. Conclusion: Detection of the NS1 antigen with antibody testing gives more specific results. Significant increase in CRP levels and a drop in platelet levels in dengue-positive patients are early indicators of presumptive diagnosis. Integrated haematological, and inflammatory markers facilitate efficient risk stratification and enhance early dengue identification, enabling prompt clinical therapy during periods of peak transmission.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 评估血清学标志物与登革热临床疑似病例的血液学、生化和炎症参数之间的关联。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究纳入了154例表现为急性发热疾病的患者。
analysis_zh.methods: DENV 诊断 采用免疫层析试剂盒对NS1抗原和IgM、IgG抗体进行了检测,该试剂盒来源于血清样本。
analysis_zh.main_results: 单独检测NS1抗原发现了17/74(23%)的感染,但结合NS1和抗体检测则将感染率提高到了约20/73(27.3%)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 他们还显示,在38例中的33例(86.8%)中C反应蛋白(CRP)升高,在38例中的23例(60.5%)中红细胞沉降率(ESR)升高。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 早期诊断实验室标志物的支持对于有效的临床管理和疾病控制至关重要。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 整合血液学和炎症标志物有助于高效的风险分层,并增强早期登革热的识别,从而在传播高峰期实现及时的临床治疗。

title: Dengue virus-induced thrombocytopenia is mediated by dysregulation of the RUNX1–MYH9 axis
abstract: Abstract Dengue virus (DENV) infection causes an acute febrile illness that is usually self-limiting but can become fatal. Thrombocytopenia, or a decrease in circulating platelets, is a major clinical feature of dengue and is strongly associated with the progression to dengue hemorrhagic fever and dengue shock syndrome. In this report, MYH9, a cytoskeletal protein involved in platelet maturation and release, was found to be down-regulated in DENV-infected Huh7 cell lines. The expression of RUNX1, an important transcription factor involved in megakaryopoiesis, was also decreased following DENV-infection. In-silico analysis identified three potential RUNX1 transcription-factor binding sites in the promoter region of the MYH9 gene. We therefore investigated whether RUNX1 regulates MYH9 expression during DENV-infection. Luciferase and ChIP assays showed that DENV infection affects RUNX1 binding to the MYH9 promoter, providing insight into the molecular basis of reduced MYH9 expression. Furthermore, the megakaryocyte differentiation markers GATA1, ITGB3, and MYH9 were upregulated in PMA-induced K562-cells. However, DENV infection downregulated these genes and increased the expression of the apoptosis marker gene CYCS. These findings suggest that dengue affects megakaryopoiesis through multiple mechanisms, potentially reducing platelet production while also promoting platelet destruction. Additionally, Fluorescence and electron microscopy revealed that functional defects of MYH9 may affect megakaryopoiesis biogenesis. Overall, this study provides insights into the molecular mechanisms contributing to thrombocytopenia during DENV infection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the molecular mechanisms underlying thrombocytopenia during dengue virus infection, addressing the need to identify specific factors contributing to this condition.

analysis.main_results: DENV infection led to decreased MYH9 and RUNX1 expression, and upregulated apoptosis marker CYCS expression.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings could inform future studies on dengue virus-induced thrombocytopenia and potentially lead to new therapeutic targets.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro models and does not address the full complexity of dengue virus infection in vivo, suggesting that further research is needed to validate these findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the molecular mechanisms of dengue virus-induced thrombocytopenia, identifying a potential regulatory role of RUNX1 and MYH9. The findings provide new insights into the condition and could inform future therapeutic strategies.

abstract_zh: 摘要 登革病毒(DENV)感染会导致一种急性发热性疾病,通常为自限性,但可能致命。血小板减少症,即循环血小板数量减少,是登革热的主要临床特征之一,并且与进展为登革热出血热和登革热休克综合征密切相关。本报告发现,在DENV感染的Huh7细胞系中,MYH9(一种参与血小板成熟和释放的细胞骨架蛋白)表达下调。此外,RUNX1(一种参与巨核细胞生成的重要转录因子)的表达在DENV感染后也减少。通过计算机分析,在MYH9基因的启动子区域发现了三个潜在的RUNX1转录因子结合位点。因此,我们研究了RUNX1是否在DENV感染期间调控MYH9的表达。荧光素酶和染色质免疫沉淀(ChIP)实验表明,DENV感染影响RUNX1与MYH9启动子的结合,揭示了血小板减少症的分子基础。此外,在PMA诱导的K562细胞中,巨核细胞分化标志物GATA1、ITGB3和MYH9的表达上调。然而,DENV感染下调了这些基因,并增加了凋亡标志物基因CYCS的表达。这些发现表明,登革热可能通过多种机制影响巨核细胞生成,从而减少血小板生成并促进血小板破坏。此外,荧光和电子显微镜观察显示,MYH9的功能缺陷可能影响巨核细胞生成过程。总体而言,本研究揭示了DENV感染期间血小板减少症的分子机制。

title: MDV-like endogenous viral elements act as immune rheostats in Aedes cells by modulating defensin A-mediated responses to arboviruses.
abstract: ABSTRACT Mosquito cell lines are essential tools for arbovirus research. Endogenous viral elements (EVEs) are prevalent in mosquito genomes, yet their functional effects on host immune responses remain unclear, potentially complicating experimental interpretations. In this study, we systematically characterized endogenous mosquito densovirus-like elements (EMLs) within the Aedes aegypti Aag2 cell line and found that these endogenous EMLs are transcriptionally active but translationally defective. The silencing of EML transcripts significantly diminished the replication of Zika virus (ZIKV), Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), while transiently increasing dengue virus 2 (DENV-2), thereby indicating a virus-dependent regulatory mechanism. Mechanistically, RNA sequencing after EML interference, alongside plasmid-based mimic expression, demonstrated that EML transcripts downregulate defensin A, an antimicrobial peptide produced by mosquitoes. Functional assays using synthetic defensin A showed that this peptide differentially regulates arboviral infection. Binding assays and structural modeling further supported its interaction with viral envelope proteins, while stage-restricted infection assays revealed distinct stages of action: defensin A enhanced adsorption of ZIKV, JEV, and CHIKV, but did not promote DENV-2 adsorption or entry, and instead reduced DENV-2 RNA accumulation at the post-entry replication stage. Our findings highlight a previously unrecognized role of densovirus-derived EVEs in mosquito innate immunity, extending their functional scope from the well-established PIWI-interacting RNA-mediated antiviral defense to the regulation of antimicrobial peptide-associated immune pathways. These findings emphasize the necessity of accounting for EVE activity when analyzing data derived from mosquito cell lines, and suggest that related EVE-mediated immune regulation may contribute to arbovirus dynamics in mosquitoes. IMPORTANCE Mosquito-borne viruses such as dengue, Zika, Japanese encephalitis, and chikungunya continue to threaten human health worldwide. Laboratory studies often use Aedes aegypti cell lines to investigate how these viruses interact with their mosquito hosts. Here, we show that the genomes of these cells contain endogenous viral elements derived from mosquito densoviruses. Far from being inert fossils, these sequences are transcriptionally active and regulate mosquito immunity by suppressing the antimicrobial peptide defensin A. This immune modulation influences the replication of different arboviruses in opposite ways, enhancing some while restricting others. Our findings reveal that integrated viral elements can shape the outcome of arbovirus infection, with important implications for interpreting mosquito cell culture experiments and for evaluating endogenous viral element-mediated immune regulation in mosquito–virus interactions.

In this study, we systematically characterized endogenous mosquito densovirus-like elements (EMLs) within the Aedes aegypti Aag2 cell line and found that these endogenous EMLs are transcriptionally active but translationally defective. The silencing of EML transcripts significantly diminished the replication of Zika virus (ZIKV), Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), while transiently increasing dengue virus 2 (DENV-2), thereby indicating a virus-dependent regulatory mechanism. Mechanistically, RNA sequencing after EML interference, alongside plasmid-based mimic expression, demonstrated that EML transcripts downregulate defensin A, an antimicrobial peptide produced by mosquitoes. Functional assays using synthetic defensin A showed that this peptide differentially regulates arboviral infection. Binding assays and structural modeling further supported its interaction with viral envelope proteins, while stage-restricted infection assays revealed distinct stages of action: defensin A enhanced adsorption of ZIKV, JEV, and CHIKV, but did not promote DENV-2 adsorption or entry, and instead reduced DENV-2 RNA accumulation at the post-entry replication stage. Our findings highlight a previously unrecognized role of densovirus-derived EVEs in mosquito innate immunity, extending their functional scope from the well-established PIWI-interacting RNA-mediated antiviral defense to the regulation of antimicrobial peptide-associated immune pathways. These findings emphasize the necessity of accounting for EVE activity when analyzing data derived from mosquito cell lines, and suggest that related EVE-mediated immune regulation may contribute to arbovirus dynamics in mosquitoes.IMPORTANCEMosquito-borne viruses such as dengue, Zika, Japanese encephalitis, and chikungunya continue to threaten human health worldwide. Laboratory studies often use Aedes aegypti cell lines to investigate how these viruses interact with their mosquito hosts. Here, we show that the genomes of these cells contain endogenous viral elements derived from mosquito densoviruses. Far from being inert fossils, these sequences are transcriptionally active and regulate mosquito immunity by suppressing the antimicrobial peptide defensin A. This immune modulation influences the replication of different arboviruses in opposite ways, enhancing some while restricting others. Our findings reveal that integrated viral elements can shape the outcome of arbovirus infection, with important implications for interpreting mosquito cell culture experiments and for evaluating endogenous viral element-mediated immune regulation in mosquito-virus interactions.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the role of endogenous viral elements (EVEs) in mosquito immunity, specifically in the context of arbovirus infection. This is important for interpreting experimental data from mosquito cell lines and understanding the dynamics of arbovirus interactions with their mosquito hosts.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used the Aedes aegypti Aag2 cell line to investigate the effects of endogenous mosquito densovirus-like elements (EMLs) on arbovirus replication and mosquito innate immunity.
analysis.methods: RNA sequencing and plasmid-based mimic expression were used to characterize EMLs and their effects on defensin A, an antimicrobial peptide. Functional assays and binding assays were conducted to understand the interaction between defensin A and viral envelope proteins.
analysis.main_results: EMLs were found to downregulate defensin A, which differentially regulated arboviral infection. Specifically, EMLs enhanced the replication of Zika virus (ZIKV), Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), while transiently increasing dengue virus 2 (DENV-2) replication.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study revealed a previously unrecognized role of densovirus-derived EVEs in mosquito innate immunity, extending their functional scope from antiviral defense to the regulation of antimicrobial peptide-associated immune pathways.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings highlight the importance of accounting for EVE activity when analyzing data derived from mosquito cell lines and suggest that related EVE-mediated immune regulation may contribute to arbovirus dynamics in mosquitoes, with implications for interpreting experimental data and evaluating immune regulation in mosquito–virus interactions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's findings are limited by the use of a single mosquito cell line and the need to generalize results to other mosquito species and cell lines. The evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of direct clinical application.

analysis.summary_en: This study characterized endogenous mosquito densovirus-like elements (EMLs) in Aedes aegypti Aag2 cells, revealing their role in modulating defensin A-mediated responses to arboviruses. EMLs enhance the replication of ZIKV, JEV, and CHIKV while transiently increasing DENV-2 replication, highlighting the importance of accounting for EVE activity in interpreting experimental data.

Functional assays using synthetic defensin A showed that this peptide differentially regulates arboviral infection. Binding assays and structural modeling further supported its interaction with viral envelope proteins, while stage-restricted infection assays revealed distinct stages of action: defensin A enhanced adsorption of ZIKV, JEV, and CHIKV, but did not promote DENV-2 adsorption or entry, and instead reduced DENV-2 RNA accumulation at the post-entry replication stage. Our findings highlight a previously unrecognized role of densovirus-derived EVEs in mosquito innate immunity, extending their functional scope from the well-established PIWI-interacting RNA-mediated antiviral defense to the regulation of antimicrobial peptide-associated immune pathways. These findings emphasize the necessity of accounting for EVE activity when analyzing data derived from mosquito cell lines, and suggest that related EVE-mediated immune regulation may contribute to arbovirus dynamics in mosquitoes. IMPORTANCE Mosquito-borne viruses such as dengue, Zika, Japanese encephalitis, and chikungunya continue to threaten human health worldwide. Laboratory studies often use Aedes aegypti cell lines to investigate how these viruses interact with their mosquito hosts. Here, we show that the genomes of these cells contain endogenous viral elements derived from mosquito densoviruses. Far from being inert fossils, these sequences are transcriptionally active and regulate mosquito immunity by suppressing the antimicrobial peptide defensin A. This immune modulation influences the replication of different arboviruses in opposite ways, enhancing some while restricting others. Our findings reveal that integrated viral elements can shape the outcome of arbovirus infection, with important implications for interpreting mosquito cell culture experiments and for evaluating endogenous viral element-mediated immune regulation in mosquito–virus interactions.
abstract_zh: 摘要:蚊虫细胞系是研究虫媒病毒的重要工具。内源性病毒元件(EVEs)在蚊虫中普遍存在,但它们对蚊虫免疫系统的影响尚不清楚,这可能会使实验结果的解释变得复杂。在本研究中,我们系统地表征了Aedes aegypti Aag2细胞系中的内源性蚊虫腺病毒样元件(EMLs),发现这些内源性EMLs具有转录活性但翻译缺陷。EML转录物的沉默显著降低了寨卡病毒(ZIKV)、日本脑炎病毒(JEV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)的复制,同时暂时增加了登革病毒2型(DENV-2)的复制,表明存在一种病毒依赖性的调节机制。机制上,EML干扰后的RNA测序以及基于质粒的模拟表达显示,EML转录物会下调蚊虫产生的抗菌肽defensin A。使用合成defensin A进行的功能实验表明,这种肽可以差异性地调节虫媒病毒的感染。结合实验和结构建模进一步支持了其与病毒包膜蛋白的相互作用,而阶段限制性感染实验则揭示了其作用的不同阶段:defensin A增强了ZIKV、JEV和CHIKV的吸附,但并未促进DENV-2的吸附或进入,反而在进入后的复制阶段减少了DENV-2的RNA积累。我们的研究揭示了源自蚊虫腺病毒的EVEs在蚊虫先天免疫中以前未被认识的作用,将它们的功能范围从已知的PIWI相互作用RNA介导的防御机制扩展到抗菌肽相关免疫通路的调控。这些发现强调了在分析源自蚊虫细胞系的数据时,必须考虑EVE活性的重要性,并提示相关的EVE介导的免疫调控可能影响蚊虫中的虫媒病毒动态。重要性:登革热、寨卡病毒、日本脑炎病毒和基孔肯雅病毒等蚊媒病毒继续威胁全球人类健康。实验室研究通常使用Aedes aegypti细胞系来研究这些病毒如何与其蚊虫宿主相互作用。在这里,我们展示了这些细胞中的内源性病毒元件源自蚊虫腺病毒。这些序列远非惰性化石,它们具有转录活性,并通过抑制抗菌肽defensin A来调节蚊虫免疫。这种免疫调节对不同虫媒病毒的复制产生相反的影响,增强某些病毒的复制,同时限制其他病毒的复制。我们的研究结果揭示了整合的病毒元件可以影响虫媒病毒感染的结果,这对解释蚊虫细胞培养实验以及评估内源性病毒元件介导的免疫调控在蚊虫-病毒相互作用中的意义具有重要影响。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解内源性病毒元件(EVEs)在蚊虫免疫中的作用,特别是在虫媒病毒感染的背景下。这对于解释源自蚊虫细胞系的实验数据以及理解虫媒病毒与其蚊虫宿主的相互作用动态具有重要意义。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用Aedes aegypti Aag2细胞系来研究内源性蚊虫腺病毒样元件(EMLs)对虫媒病毒复制和蚊虫先天免疫的影响。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过RNA测序和基于质粒的模拟表达来表征EMLs及其对抗菌肽defensin A的影响。进行了功能实验和结合实验以了解defensin A与病毒包膜蛋白的相互作用。
analysis_zh.main_results: 发现EMLs会下调defensin A,从而差异性地调控虫媒病毒感染。具体而言,EMLs增强了寨卡病毒(ZIKV)、日本脑炎病毒(JEV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)的复制,同时暂时增加了登革病毒2型(DENV-2)的复制。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究揭示了源自蚊虫腺病毒的EVEs在蚊虫先天免疫中以前未被认识的作用,将它们的功能范围从PIWI相互作用RNA介导的防御机制扩展到抗菌肽相关免疫通路的调控。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了在分析源自蚊虫细胞系的数据时,必须考虑EVE活性的重要性,并提示相关的EVE介导的免疫调控可能影响蚊虫中的虫媒病毒动态,对解释实验数据和评估蚊虫-病毒相互作用中的免疫调控具有重要意义。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的发现受到单一蚊虫细胞系使用的影响,且需要将结果推广到其他蚊虫物种和细胞系。由于缺乏直接的临床应用,证据强度中等。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to highlight the importance of considering secondary bacterial infections, particularly septic pulmonary embolism, in patients recovering from dengue fever who present with focal soft-tissue infection, respiratory symptoms, or markedly elevated inflammatory markers. This is due to the potential for severe complications following dengue fever.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a case report describing a single patient who developed septic pulmonary embolism secondary to lower-limb cellulitis following recent dengue fever, complicated by hydropneumothorax. The study focused on the clinical course and diagnostic challenges encountered in this specific case.
analysis.methods: The case was documented through clinical observation, imaging studies, and laboratory tests. Blood cultures were performed, and radiological findings were used to establish the diagnosis of septic pulmonary embolism despite negative blood cultures. The patient's clinical history and symptoms were also reviewed.
analysis.main_results: The patient developed septic pulmonary embolism secondary to lower-limb cellulitis following dengue fever, which was confirmed through radiological findings. Blood cultures were negative, and infective endocarditis was not present.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that septic pulmonary embolism can occur as a complication of dengue fever, even in the absence of infective endocarditis, and that radiological findings may be crucial in diagnosing such conditions when blood cultures are negative. This case adds to the understanding of post-dengue complications.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the need for clinicians to consider septic pulmonary embolism as a potential complication in patients recovering from dengue fever who exhibit focal soft-tissue infections or respiratory symptoms. This can inform improved diagnostic approaches and surveillance strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single case report, which may not be representative of broader trends. However, the evidence is strong given the detailed clinical and radiological documentation provided.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a patient who developed septic pulmonary embolism secondary to lower-limb cellulitis following dengue fever, complicated by hydropneumothorax. The study highlights the importance of considering secondary bacterial infections in patients recovering from dengue fever who present with focal soft-tissue infection, respiratory symptoms, or elevated inflammatory markers. The authors emphasize that radiological findings may be essential in diagnosing septic pulmonary embolism when blood cultures are negative. The case adds to the understanding of post-dengue complications and underscores the need for clinicians to remain vigilant about potential secondary infections. The study is limited to a single case, but the detailed documentation supports its relevance to clinical practice and surveillance. The evidence suggests that septic pulmonary embolism can occur as a complication of dengue fever, even in the absence of infective endocarditis, and that radiological findings may be crucial in such scenarios.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在强调在恢复期登革热的患者中,特别是那些出现局部软组织感染或呼吸系统症状的患者,考虑继发性细菌感染,尤其是肺栓塞的重要性。这是因为登革热后可能出现严重的并发症。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究描述了一名患者在恢复期登革热后继发下肢蜂窝炎并伴有胸腔积液和气胸的情况。研究重点在于该特定病例的临床过程和诊断挑战。
elements_zh.methods: 通过临床观察、影像学检查和实验室测试记录了该病例。进行了血液培养,并使用影像学发现来确定肺栓塞的诊断,尽管血液培养结果为阴性。还回顾了患者的临床病史和症状。
elements_zh.main_results: 该患者在恢复期登革热后继发下肢蜂窝炎并出现肺栓塞,通过影像学检查确诊。血液培养结果为阴性,且无感染性心内膜炎。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,即使在没有感染性心内膜炎的情况下,登革热后也可能发生肺栓塞,并且影像学发现可能在血液培养结果为阴性时对于诊断此类情况至关重要。该病例增加了对登革热后并发症的理解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了在恢复期登革热的患者中,如果出现局部软组织感染或呼吸系统症状,应考虑肺栓塞作为潜在并发症。这可以指导改进诊断方法和监测策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于一个病例,可能不具备广泛的代表性。然而,鉴于提供的详细临床和影像学记录,证据强度较强。

title: Economic Burden of Inappropriate Antibiotic Prescribing Attributable to Dengue in Singapore.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue has a clinical presentation similar to that of bacterial infections, creating diagnostic uncertainty that may lead to inappropriate antibiotic prescribing. OBJECTIVE: To estimate the magnitude of inappropriate antibiotic prescribing attributable to dengue in Singapore and assess the associated economic burden from healthcare system and societal perspectives over the period 2015-2024. METHODS: A decision tree model was developed to determine costs associated with 142,525 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases reported in Singapore during 2015-2024. National surveillance data and prescribing rates informed model inputs. Costs were estimated from healthcare system and societal perspectives and expressed in 2025 Singapore dollars (SGD). Deterministic and probabilistic sensitivity analyses were conducted. RESULTS: The model estimated 7055 antibiotic prescriptions, of which 6866 were inappropriate; 79.6% of inappropriate prescriptions occurred in ambulatory care. The cumulative burden associated with the 2015-2024 caseload was SGD 14.32 million from the healthcare system perspective and SGD 16.13 million from the societal perspective. Prolonged hospitalisation was the largest cost component followed by adverse drug events due to antibiotic use. In the probabilistic analysis, the mean societal burden was SGD 16.16 million, with a 95% uncertainty interval of SGD 2.78-49.60 million. CONCLUSIONS: In this analysis, inappropriate antibiotic prescribing attributable to dengue was associated with an estimated cumulative economic burden of SGD 14.32 million from the healthcare system perspective and SGD 16.13 million from the societal perspective in Singapore during 2015-2024, expressed in 2025 values. Direct medical costs accounted for most of the burden, and the findings support further evaluation of approaches to reduce unnecessary prescribing.

title_zh: 新加坡2015-2024年因登革热导致的不适当抗生素处方的经济负担。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue has a clinical presentation similar to that of bacterial infections, creating diagnostic uncertainty that may lead to inappropriate antibiotic prescribing. OBJECTIVE: To estimate the magnitude of inappropriate antibiotic prescribing attributable to dengue in Singapore and assess the associated economic burden from healthcare system and societal perspectives over the period 2015-2024. METHODS: A decision tree model was developed to determine costs associated with 142,525 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases reported in Singapore during 2015-2024. National surveillance data and prescribing rates informed model inputs. Costs were estimated from healthcare system and societal perspectives and expressed in 2025 Singapore dollars (SGD). Deterministic and probabilistic sensitivity analyses were conducted. RESULTS: The model estimated 7055 antibiotic prescriptions, of which 6866 were inappropriate; 79.6% of inappropriate prescriptions occurred in ambulatory care. The cumulative burden associated with the 2015-2024 caseload was SGD 14.32 million from the healthcare system perspective and SGD 16.13 million from the societal perspective. Prolonged hospitalisation was the largest cost component followed by adverse drug events due to antibiotic use. In the probabilistic analysis, the mean societal burden was SGD 16.16 million, with a 95% uncertainty interval of SGD 2.78-49.60 million. CONCLUSIONS: In this analysis, inappropriate antibiotic prescribing attributable to dengue was associated with an estimated cumulative economic burden of SGD 14.32 million from the healthcare system perspective and SGD 16.13 million from the societal perspective in Singapore during 2015-2024, expressed in 2025 values. Direct medical costs accounted for most of the burden, and the findings support further evaluation of approaches to reduce unnecessary prescribing.
abstract_zh: 背景:登革热的临床表现与细菌感染相似,导致诊断不确定,可能引发不恰当的抗生素处方。目的:估计新加坡因登革热导致的不恰当抗生素处方的规模,并评估2015‐2024 年期间从医疗系统和社会视角的经济负担。方法:构建决策树模型,计算2015‐2024 年新加坡报告的142,525 例实验室确诊的登革热病例相关费用。模型输入基于国家 监测 数据和处方率。费用从医疗系统和社会视角估算,并以2025 年新加坡元(SGD)表示。进行了确定性和概率性敏感性分析。结果:模型估计共7055 份抗生素处方,其中6866 份为不恰当;不恰当处方中79.6%发生在门诊护理。与2015‐2024 年病例负荷相关的累计负担为医疗系统视角下 SGD 14.32 百万,社会视角下 SGD 16.13 百万。住院时间延长是最大费用构成,其次是抗生素使用导致的不良药物事件。概率分析显示,社会平均负担为 SGD 16.16 百万,95% 不确定区间为 SGD 2.78‐49.60 百万。结论:本分析表明,登革热导致的不恰当抗生素处方在2015‐2024 年期间给新加坡带来了医疗系统视角下 SGD 14.32 百万、社会视角下 SGD 16.13 百万的累计经济负担(以2025 年价值计)。直接医疗费用占大部分负担,研究结果支持进一步评估降低不必要处方的措施。
